data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/view.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-role schema for manifests/<saas>/views/<View>.yaml body (post-_meta-strip). Requires name + entry; url_patterns / identifying_selectors / widgets / landmarks / exit are optional. Runtime validator enforces widget refs + entry recipe vocabulary.
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled for v0

title: Spec 60 — views/<View>.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-SaaS view definition file (e.g. manifests/gmail/views/Inbox.yaml) after _meta is stripped. name + entry required.

name.description: View name (CamelCase). Matches the file basename.

entry.description: How the runtime navigates to this view. Either url-based (entry.url) or recipe-based (entry.recipe).

exit.description: Optional exit/teardown recipe — array of step objects used between view tests to leave compose dialogs, dismiss modals, etc.

url_patterns.description: URL patterns (substring or regex) the runtime uses to detect the view is current.

identifying_selectors.description: CSS selectors that must be present on the page when this view is active.

widgets.description: Flat list of widget ids reachable from this view (propose-authored runtime shape).

landmarks.description: Per-landmark widget refs + extraction rules (seed-manifest canonical shape).
